identification: Five Australian silver threepences in old handwritten 2x2 cards: 1915 (George V, London mint, card 'scarce date, strong reverse', looks about Fine to VF in the small photo), 1921-M (card 'light tone, almost uncirculated'), 1951 PL (card UNC), 1952 (card UNC), 1955 (card UNC). Useful: Renniks/PCGS-style catalogue values for 1915 3d (VF) and 1921M 3d (aUNC).
viewing_check: Look at the 1915 under a loupe: wear on the kangaroo/emu and shield detail and date; anything better than VF lifts it towards A$125-150. Check the 1921-M for lustre (true aUNC) and that the M is there under the date. Check none are cleaned (hairlines). 1950s coins are near silver value regardless.
